rules.conservative_links: lineage links plus any identical eligible protein shared by two records

evidence_tiers.anchor_only: reviewed UniProt anchor only; deposited text is silent or names only a partner
evidence_tiers.corroborated: reviewed UniProt anchor (identity >= 0.90, anchor coverage >= 0.80) and the deposited CDS name or note names the same family

lineage_links: same direct submission (authors and submission text, including date and address)
same unpublished or catalog reference title
near-copy constructs: at least 90% of the sampled canonical 25-mers of each record are in the other

low_similarity.query: whole protein; anchor region residues for fusion-class components

rules.partition: connected components of the conservative graph; the largest goes to holdout; of the rest, those ranking in the lowest 20% by sha256(seed:first accession) go to development

segmentation.rule: Pyrodigal candidates in length order; a candidate longer than the window is replaced by windows at the stride, the last ending at the candidate end
